items.label: le cabaret
items.scene: A frog in a top hat sings on a tiny CABARET stage (kah-bah-REH) at the end of the bar, one bright RAY of spotlight on him.

items.label: le couscous
items.scene: A pigeon goes 'COO! COO!' (koos-KOOS) as it pecks at a steaming dome of COUSCOUS crowned with vegetables.

items.label: le plat
items.scene: SPLAT! (PLAH) A clumsy duck in a blue waistcoat tips a DISH of spaghetti so it pours down onto the plate below.

items.label: le restaurateur
items.scene: The RESTAURANT OWNER, a silver-haired lady, counts the day's banknotes while her helper, a RAT in a waistcoat (rehs-toh-rah-TUHR), stacks the coins.

items.label: le banquet
items.scene: A brass KEY-ring skewer (bahn-KEH) stands upright in the roast chicken on a long BANQUET platter with grapes and bread.

items.label: l'hors-d'œuvre
items.scene: A white DOVE (or-DUHVR) pecks at a little tray of HORS D'OEUVRES: cheese and tomato STARTERS on cocktail sticks.

items.label: le bistro
items.scene: A tiny model BISTRO (bees-TROH) with a red awning sits inside a snow globe on the bar.
